ai_summary.key_headline: Les Bleus' Midfield Core Faces Physical Senegal Press

france.philosophy: High-transition direct attacking with fluid front-four positioning.

senegal.philosophy: High-intensity defensive press with rapid wing transitions.

tactical_insights: France will look to break Senegal's low block through Griezmann's progressive passing between the lines.
Senegal's wingers Jackson and Sarr will target France's advanced fullbacks on counter-attacks.
The midfield battle between Camavinga and Pape Sarr will dictate the tempo and possession share.
